label: Armor status
on_description: the armor status display is enabled
description: Worn armor and held item with remaining durability.
settings_description: Settings for the Armor status HUD mod. Reads `InventoryPlayer.armorInventory` durability, pushed only when it changes.

orientation.description: Whether armor pieces are laid out left to right or top to bottom.

show_durability.description: Whether to print remaining durability as a number under each piece.

show_held_item.description: Whether to include the currently held item as a sixth slot.

warn_below.description: Fraction of maximum durability under which a piece's bar turns amber. A threshold on a live value, the same species as `ping.good_ms`: the point at which a player wants to be told their gear is going is a matter of how they play, not a constant. 0 never warns.
